sentences.en: The configuration file for your database server is located in this directory.
sentences.zh: 你的数据库服务器配置文件位于这个目录。

sentences.en: We were running out of disk space due to a configuration issue.
sentences.zh: 由于配置问题，我们快没空间了。

sentences.en: We encounter similar difficulties when we substitute rectangles for triangles in this configuration.
sentences.zh: 当我们用三角形替换此处的矩形时，我们会遇到类似的问题。
